Coloring tips:
• Slip a sheet of paper behind the page you are coloring.
• Each picture is printed on one side only.
• There is no wrong way to color!

Sample project note: the illustrations in this demonstration project were drawn procedurally by Coloring Book Studio as placeholders. Replace them with your own or properly licensed artwork before publishing.

data.back_copy:
Grab your crayons and visit a sunny island full of friendly animals! Inside you will find 40 original illustrations with big, bold shapes made for little hands.

• 40 single-sided designs
• Blank back on every page
• 8.5 × 11 in pages

conflicts: One indexed copy of the KDP cover page text mentions the barcode at the lower LEFT of the back cover, while the KDP barcode help pages (GDTKFJPNQCBTMRV6, G5HDYGP4BXLX4RUW) state the lower RIGHT. This app reserves the lower-right corner (used by both barcode pages) — confirm against your official cover template.

KDP prints spine text only on books with more than 79 pages. Third-party guides cite a ~0.2–0.25 in minimum spine width instead. The app requires BOTH the page-count rule and that the text fits between 0.0625 in fold clearances.

reasons: Usable spine width is 0.064 in after 0.0625 in fold clearances; 10.0 pt text needs 0.139 in.

listing.author: Your Name
listing.category_notes: Research categories yourself in KDP's category picker. This app does not provide category IDs or rankings.
listing.description: Forty original cartoon animal scenes set on a sunny island: sandcastles, surfing, sailing and beach picnics. Every illustration is printed on its own page with a blank back to reduce marker bleed-through. Large shapes and bold outlines suit young colorists.
listing.subtitle: A Coloring Book for Kids Ages 4–7
listing.title: Cute Island Adventures

pricing_profile.effective_note: Reference values read from KDP's Paperback Printing Cost and Paperback Royalty help pages on 2026-10-30. This is a dated reference profile, not live data. Confirm with the official calculator.

expanded_distribution.note: Expanded Distribution is kept separate and disabled by default. Eligibility depends on the specific book (trim, paper, ISBN choice); do not assume a coloring book qualifies.

pricing_profile.large_trim_rule: Width more than 6.12 in or height more than 9 in
